entities.name: Lukya
entities.description: A copper wolf, companion of Lathril and child of the Cosmos Wolf Sarulf on Kaldheim.

entities.name: Lathril
entities.description: A queen who became a deity-like figure for her people and companion of Lukya.

entities.name: Sarulf
entities.description: The immortal Cosmos Wolf, sire of Lukya.

entities.name: Lyana
entities.description: A young girl rescued from assailants with Lukya's help.

events.summary: Sarulf gifts Lukya to Queen Lathril after Lathril's transformative ordeal.
events.quote: Lukya appeared as a gift from her sire, the Cosmos Wolf Sarulf

events.summary: Lukya accompanies Lathril in battles against draugrs and helps rescue the child Lyana from assailants.
events.quote: helping rescue the child Lyana from assailants

events.summary: Lukya meets Sarulf, who acknowledges her as a chosen child and grants additional blessings.
events.quote: she is acknowledged as one of his chosen children

relations.quote: a child of the Cosmos Wolf Sarulf
Lukya was the wolf companion of Lathril
comforting and providing a sense of security to the young girl
